Company Profile
Company name:
SHUFUNOTOMO Co.,Ltd.
Founded:
September 18 ,1916
Capital:
100 million yen
President:
Toshiyasu Omiya
Business operations:
Magazine & book publishing
Employees:
115(As of April 2025)
Address:
MEGURO CENTRAL SQUARE,
3-1-1 Kami-osaki, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo 141-0021
History
Shufunotomo Co., Ltd., established in 1916, has over 100 years of rich history, making it one of Japan's most enduring and respected publishers. We started our journey by publishing the monthly magazine "Shufunotomo" to enrich housewives’ life and expand their happiness. Nowadays, we are widely recognized for its diverse range of publications in books and magazines over 300 new titles/year across various genres, including wellness, cooking, gardening, parenting, education, children’s books, autobiographical novels, self-help and fiction. Our mission is to enrich the lives of its readers by delivering discovery and inspirations. We also commit to translation-publishing business by joining oversea bookfairs to engage in discussions with oversea publishers.
